product_context:
Internal brief only. Do not dump this into the email.

WHAT IT IS: Stockline helps independent coffee-shop owners see what they actually used last week before they place the next wholesale order.
WHO TO WRITE: owner-operators who still order from a spreadsheet, last week's invoice, or memory. Not restaurant consultants. Not Square/Toast salespeople.
TRIGGER TO INFER: they talk about over-ordering milk, running out of a pastry, or rebuilding the order list every Sunday. They do not need to have asked for inventory software.
EMAIL SHAPE: one observed fact about their ordering week → I am building Stockline for that → one low-friction question.
Never invent customers, launches, or metrics.
sender_block:
=== SENDER (verified for this campaign) ===
- Name: Sam
- Company: Stockline
- Current work: helping independent coffee shops order from last week's actual usage instead of a rebuilt spreadsheet
- Desired outcome: a short call about how they place the weekly wholesale order
- Recipient value: they spend less Sunday night rebuilding the same list
- Constraints: only use facts from the research file; no fake customers or numbers
=== end sender ===

discovery.what_it_does: Shows independent coffee-shop owners what they actually used last week so the next wholesale order is not rebuilt from memory.
discovery.target_users_or_buyers: Owner-operators of 1-5 location coffee shops in North America who still place the weekly order themselves.
problems_it_solves: Rebuilding the wholesale order from last week's invoice or a spreadsheet every Sunday
Over-ordering milk or pastries because usage is not written down
Running out mid-week and placing a panic order
examples_of_problem_signals: I still do the wholesale order myself every Sunday from last week's invoice
We ran out of oat milk again because I guessed the order
The spreadsheet is a mess so I just copy last week and hope
obvious_non_targets_or_adjacent_vendors: People selling Square, Toast, or other restaurant POS / inventory products
Consultants writing about cafe operations without owning a shop
discovery.search_guidance: Do not hunt for people asking for inventory software. Hunt for coffee-shop owners who still personally place the weekly wholesale order and complain about guessing, copying last week, or running out.
